title: Iran whips singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 times over YouTube concert
html:
Iran whips singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 times over YouTube concert

Iranian authorities have lashed singer Parastoo Ahmadi over a 2024 performance streamed live on YouTube. The 29-year-old appeared in a dress and without a mandatory hijab in the widely-shared concert.
summary: Iranian authorities have lashed singer Parastoo Ahmadi over a 2024 performance streamed live on YouTube.
